mentions.heading: Expanding manufacturing footprint in Asian markets including China
mentions.detail: Strategy grows footprint in China, Asia and lower-cost regions, increasing exposure to geopolitical and country risks
mentions.quote: Increasing our manufacturing footprint in Asian markets, including China, and our business relationships with Asian automotive manufacturers are important elements of our long-term strategy. In addition, our strategy includes increasing revenue and expanding our manufacturing footprint in lower-cost regions. As a result, our exposure to the risks described above may be greater in the future.

mentions.heading: Failure to manage growth or integrate acquisitions could harm business
mentions.detail: Acquired Wind River and Intercable Automotive Solutions in 2022; continues pursuing possibly material deals
mentions.quote: We have completed a number of acquisitions in recent years, including the acquisitions of Wind River and Intercable Automotive Solutions S.r.l. in 2022.

mentions.heading: Failure to manage growth or integrate acquisitions could harm business
mentions.detail: Failure to integrate acquired companies profitably may impair goodwill and intangibles
mentions.quote: Likewise, our failure to integrate and manage acquired companies profitably may lead to future impairment of any associated goodwill and intangible asset balances.

mentions.heading: Cybersecurity risks for infrastructure and products
mentions.detail: Covers infrastructure and products; AI-enabled attacks and remote work raise vulnerability
mentions.quote: Cyberattacks are continually increasing in their frequency, sophistication and intensity. Additionally, some actors are using artificial intelligence technology to launch more automated, targeted and coordinated attacks which further heightens these risks.
